user_story.capability: motion detection to use the fast hardware secondary stream whenever it's safely available
user_story.benefit: the camera recovers visibility faster after a reconnect without ever losing motion coverage

criteria.trigger: motion detection starts a new capture session AND `motion_use_secondary_stream` is enabled AND `sub_stream_enabled` is enabled AND `text_overlay_enabled` is disabled
criteria.behavior: connect to the secondary (`sub`) RTSP path as its frame source

criteria.trigger: `motion_use_secondary_stream` is disabled, OR `sub_stream_enabled` is disabled, OR `text_overlay_enabled` is enabled
criteria.behavior: connect to the `main` RTSP path as its frame source

criteria.trigger: a settings change updates `motion_use_secondary_stream`, `sub_stream_enabled`, or `text_overlay_enabled` while motion detection is running
criteria.behavior: apply the resulting source-selection outcome (R1.1 or R1.2) starting from its next reconnect

criteria.trigger: the frame source selected for the current session disconnects or fails
criteria.behavior: apply its existing reconnect/backoff behavior against that same source, and SHALL NOT switch to the other source mid-session
always resolve to exactly one of `main` or the secondary (`sub`) path as its frame source; no code path SHALL leave the source unresolved

user_story.capability: the generated mediamtx configuration to request an MJPEG secondary stream (not hardware H264)
user_story.benefit: the secondary stream actually delivers the fast-reconnect, low-decode-cost behavior motion detection depends on

criteria.behavior: render any path configured with `rpiCameraSecondary: true` using the codec configuration that yields an MJPEG stream, never the hardware H264 codec
include an explicit MJPEG quality setting on any path configured with `rpiCameraSecondary: true`

criteria.trigger: a path is the primary (non-secondary) `rpiCamera` path
criteria.behavior: continue to render it with the hardware H264 codec, unchanged from today's behavior

user_story.capability: the camera service to start reliably every time the secondary stream is configured
user_story.benefit: enabling this feature can never turn into a boot-loop on my device

criteria.behavior: start successfully, with no startup crash, when its configuration includes a secondary `rpiCamera` path, across at least 10 consecutive restarts

criteria.trigger: the running mediamtx instance does not reliably satisfy R3.1 with the corrected secondary-stream configuration in place
criteria.behavior: prevent `motion_use_secondary_stream` from taking effect and SHALL keep the Motion_Detector on the `main` source

user_story.capability: the Matter/HomeKit live view and the web UI's live view to keep working exactly as they do today
user_story.benefit: adding motion detection as a new reader of the secondary stream doesn't cost me an existing feature

criteria.trigger: the Motion_Detector is reading the secondary stream
criteria.behavior: continue to serve the Matter/HomeKit bridge's live-view stream and JPEG snapshot capture without interruption attributable to the additional reader

criteria.trigger: the Motion_Detector is reading the secondary stream
criteria.behavior: continue to serve the web UI's live-view stream without interruption attributable to the additional reader

user_story.capability: to see which video source motion detection is currently using and trust its existing health metrics
user_story.benefit: I can troubleshoot latency or reliability issues without guessing

criteria.trigger: the Motion_Detector connects to a frame source
criteria.behavior: include which source (`main` or secondary) is currently active in its existing status/health output

criteria.actor: Motion_Detector's existing blind-time and availability measurements
criteria.behavior: remain accurate regardless of whether `main` or the secondary path is the active source

user_story.capability: an explicit setting to control whether motion detection may use the secondary stream
user_story.benefit: I can roll back to the known-good `main`-only behavior without a code change if something looks wrong

criteria.behavior: expose a user-configurable control for `motion_use_secondary_stream` in the motion-detection settings area
default `motion_use_secondary_stream` to disabled (false) for both new and existing installations, so behavior does not change until an operator explicitly opts in
